name: Sri Lanka
dek: Colombo, WMO 43466. Not the hill country and not the east coast.
paragraphs: The reference station is Colombo, WMO 43466, height 7 m. Hambantota has its own file and was not averaged in; Kandy and the east coast are not this table. No official driving-side or tipping page was opened on this pass, so those lines are missing.

The highest average high in the table is 32.0 °C, in March and April. The lowest average low is 23.1 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is October, at 359.3 mm, and the driest is February, at 77.4 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Colombo, WMO 43466. Not Kandy, not the east coast, and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type D, G and M, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Sri Lanka at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Sri Lanka, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Sri Lanka Rupee and the code LKR for Sri Lanka.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Sri Lanka one row, Asia/Colombo. There is no second zone for the country in either file.
